responsive_verification.method: measured in a real browser: documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth, plus a sweep for elements extending past the viewport

scientific_honesty_enforced.river_flood_scope: station/gauge only; discrete markers, never area polygons; no flash-flood or nationwide claim
scientific_honesty_enforced.food_security_scope: region only; explicitly separated from official IPC classification
scientific_honesty_enforced.drought_scope: district; explicitly not a famine forecast and not an IPC classification

defects_found_and_fixed_by_own_tests: cadence formatter rendered '3.0 mo' instead of '3 mo'
per-hook retry overrode the QueryClient policy, defeating test configuration
data-autofocus lost to document order in overlay focus selection
corrupted regex literal containing a control character
four interactive targets below the WCAG 2.5.8 24px minimum
known_limitations: Backend defines no reject or hold alert transition; UI offers the real transitions and explains the absence
/alerts has no server-side filtering; filtering and pagination are client-side
/risks does not return station coordinates; unmappable gauges are counted and listed, never positioned by guesswork
Administration is read-only; account creation involves credential issuance and scope assignment
No basemap bundled; boundaries render on a plain ground unless VITE_MAP_STYLE_URL is set
i18n covers navigation and status vocabulary; methodological text stays English by design

phase_04_dependency.evidence: grep -rn 'operational' backend/app returns no matches; no Phase 04 documents exist in the repository
phase_04_dependency.consequence: Phase 03 operational intelligence on disk (87 drought districts, 5 flood stations, 18 food-security regions) is not reachable through any API endpoint
phase_04_dependency.frontend_behaviour: reports PARTIAL/STALE and 'No evidence' truthfully; no green Operational indicator is forced
forward_compatibility: toSeverity accepts the Phase 03 'SEVERE' spelling alongside the API 'critical'
driver rendering already understands the contract reason_code vocabulary
